author: Athul Prem
research_question: Does the small directed reflected-conversion pair at 887500000 Hz persist under one matched archived h80 z4/z6 joint body/port thickness-discretization increment?
observable: Two separate unit-power directed conversion powers, all five R/T responses and all 50 raw/gauge-aligned propagating complex coefficients at original planes.

predeclared_targets.A: abs(P_z4_8875-P_z6_8875)/P_z6_8875 <= 0.10, for each separate directed drive
predeclared_targets.A_interpretation: Declared finite power sensitivity, not 10% accuracy or an uncertainty bound.
predeclared_targets.B: P_z_8875/P_z_1GHz <= 0.01 separately for both directions and both z resolutions
predeclared_targets.B_interpretation: At least 99% suppression in each saved discretization; independent of A.
